SELECT T4.COUNTER_ID counterId, T4.COUNTER_TYPE counterType, T4.COUNTER_NAME counterName, T4.LINK_ID finprodId, PARTY_ID partyId, T4.TYPE_6 type1, T4.TYPE_7 type2, T5.CUSTOMER_NAME managerId, T6.CUSTOMER_NAME trusteeId FROM ( SELECT T1.COUNTER_ID, T1.COUNTER_TYPE, T1.COUNTER_NAME, T1.LINK_ID, T1.PARTY_ID, CASE T1.COUNTER_TYPE WHEN '03' THEN T2.ISSUER WHEN '02' THEN T1.MANAGER_ID ELSE '' END AS MANA, T2.TRUSTEE_ID, T3.TYPE_6, T3.TYPE_7 FROM MST_COUNTER_PARTY T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T1.LINK_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T3 ON T1.LINK_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID
AND T1.COUNTER_TYPE = #{counterType}
AND T1.COUNTER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{counterId},'%'))
AND T1.COUNTER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{counterName},'%'))
AND T1.PARTY_ID in
#{item}
ORDER BY T1.COUNTER_TYPE DESC ) T4 LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T5 ON T5.CUSTOMER_ID = T4.MANA AND T5.IS_ASSTE_MANAGER = 'Y' LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T6 ON T6.CUSTOMER_ID = T4.TRUSTEE_ID AND T6.IS_TRUSTER = 'Y'

SELECT T1.COUNTER_TYPE id, T1.COUNTER_NAME text, '' col FROM MST_COUNTER_PARTY T1
AND T1.COUNTER_TYPE = #{counterType}
AND T1.COUNTER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{counterId},'%'))
AND T1.COUNTER_NAME like CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{counterName},'%'))
ORDER BY T1.COUNTER_TYPE
SELECT COUNTER_ID id, ACCT_NO text, '' col FROM MST_COUNTER_ACCT
SELECT COUNTER_ID id, COUNTER_TYPE text FROM MST_COUNTER_PARTY

SELECT CUSTOMER_ID id, CUSTOMER_NAME text, CUSTOMER_NAME object FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO
IS_ASSTE_MANAGER = 'Y'
AND (CUSTOMER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')) OR CUSTOMER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')))

SELECT INSTITUTION_CODE id, INSTITUTION_NAME text, INSTITUTION_NAME object FROM SYS_INSTITUTION
AND (INSTITUTION_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')) OR INSTITUTION_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')))

SELECT CUSTOMER_ID id, CUSTOMER_NAME text FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO
IS_TRUSTER = 'Y'
AND (CUSTOMER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')) OR CUSTOMER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')))
SELECT COUNT(*) count FROM MST_COUNTER_PARTY, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.COUNTER_ID AND MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_ID = #{counterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 WHERE T1.FINPROD_NAME = #{counterName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T1.FINPROD_ID != #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT ACCT_NAME acctName, BANK_DEP bankDep, LARGE_PAYNO largePayno FROM STL_CAPACCT_INFO WHERE ACCT_NO = #{acctNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CCY = #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT COUNTER_ID code, COUNTER_NAME shortName FROM MST_COUNTER_PARTY
(COUNTER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')) OR COUNTER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')))

SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID id, PORTFOLIO_NAME text FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO
PORTFOLIO_TYPE ='03' OR ( PORTFOLIO_TYPE ='01' AND ( PORTFOLIO_ID not in (SELECT PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO where PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID is not null) ) )
and (PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')) OR PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')))

SELECT CUSTOMER_ID id, CUSTOMER_NAME text, CUSTOMER_NAME object FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO
AND (CUSTOMER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')) OR CUSTOMER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')))

SELECT CUSTOMER_ID id, CUSTOMER_NAME text, CUSTOMER_NAME object FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO
CUSTOMER_TYPE = '01'
AND (CUSTOMER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')) OR CUSTOMER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')))
AND CUSTOMER_ID = #{initValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT COUNT(1) count FROM FIN_POST_INVEST_INFO WHERE POST_ORG = #{counterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT PARTY_ID FROM MST_COUNTER_PARTY WHERE PARTY_ID IS NOT NULL
